properties.description: Data collection rule for SecurityScorecard Cybersecurity Ratings connector

dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend TimeGenerated = now(), Body = 'OverAll', Src = 'OverallScore', Subject = '', DateYesterday = tostring(date), DateToday = tostring(date), ScoreYesterday = toint(score), ScoreToday = toint(score), ScoreChange = 0, Industry = '', Severity = '', PortfolioId = '', PortfolioName = '' | project TimeGenerated, Body, Src, Subject, DateYesterday, DateToday, ScoreYesterday, ScoreToday, ScoreChange, Industry, Severity, PortfolioId, PortfolioName

source | extend TimeGenerated = now(), Body = 'Factor', Factor = '', FactorName = '', Subject = '', DateYesterday = tostring(date), DateToday = tostring(date), ScoreYesterday = 0, ScoreToday = 0, ScoreChange = 0, FactorDescription = '', Industry = '', Severity = '', PortfolioId = '', PortfolioName = '' | project TimeGenerated, Body, Factor, FactorName, Subject, DateYesterday, DateToday, ScoreYesterday, ScoreToday, ScoreChange, FactorDescription, Industry, Severity, PortfolioId, PortfolioName

source | extend TimeGenerated = now(), Body = 'Issue', Factor = tostring(factor), EventId = tostring(id), Subject = '', Date = tostring(date), IssueType = tostring(issue_type), FindingsCount = tostring(issue_count), GroupStatus = tostring(group_status), IssueName = '', TotalScoreImpact = todouble(total_score_impact), SeverityValue = tostring(severity), DetailUrl = tostring(detail_url), Industry = '', Severity = '', PortfolioId = '', PortfolioName = '' | project TimeGenerated, Body, Factor, EventId, Subject, Date, IssueType, FindingsCount, GroupStatus, IssueName, TotalScoreImpact, SeverityValue, DetailUrl, Industry, Severity, PortfolioId, PortfolioName
